title: cards.json
description: The deck read by the render engine. Field names are the engine's own (French) so a deck renders unchanged; the descriptions are in English. The image block differs from the engine's raw form: it points at images.json, and the server fills the file, credit and licence from Wikimedia Commons before rendering.

campagne.description: A short slug for the piece.

pilier.description: Optional content series or theme label from the project profile.

accent.description: Optional accent token name from the project's brand kit. Checked at render time.

fond.description: Optional ground token name from the project's brand kit. Checked at render time.

licence_sortie.description: Ignored: the deck licence is computed from the images, never copied.

rang.description: Position in the deck, 1..n with no gap.

role.description: `ouverture` for the cover (first card only), `bascule` for the closing card, `contenu` for the rest.

titre.description: Cover: eight words at most. Every sentence: twenty words at most.

chiffre.description: True when `titre` is a single figure or word set large; then it is not a sentence.

precision.description: A short line under the title.

corps.description: Body text. Subject first, reference after.

source.description: Short, identifiable source printed on the card. Required on every card after the cover except a closing card that only invites.

identite.description: One sentence on what the image shows, without naming its author or licence.

pivot.description: The one word or phrase set in the accent colour; never deduced by the engine.

coupe.description: Forced title line breaks; null unless the break carries meaning.

disposition.description: Layout choice; `auto` unless there is a written reason.
